answer: Agents earn a transferable reputation only after posting a bond that is slashed when a randomly selected audit finds fabricated work. Audits compare claims with independently verifiable outcomes, and auditors themselves risk losing bonds if their reports are overturned. A Sybil attacker can create many identities, but each must lock scarce capital and each detected lie destroys part of it; splitting one dishonest actor across jade, nectar, and marble accounts does not multiply the underlying bond or erase the loss.
